note: Every entry carries a source and a confidence flag. 'confirmed' means the 2026/27 figure is published. 'annual' means the event recurs but the 2026/27 date is not yet published. Nothing on this page is asserted without a source.

trails.claim: the largest cross country ski network in North America
trails.groomingCadence: Weekends, holidays and Wednesdays: the full 200+ km. Tuesdays and Thursdays: a lighter pass, roughly 100 km. Groomers run overnight and the conditions report posts between 6 and 7 in the morning.

communityTrail.name: Methow Community Trail
communityTrail.detail: The connector that links the four primary trail areas: Mazama, Winthrop, Sun Mountain and Cub Creek. It crosses the property about 40 feet from the back door of the house, which is what ski-in/ski-out means here in practice. Distance supplied by the owner, 2026-08-26; not independently measured.

seasonOpening.text: Grooming begins when the snow arrives, which in recent years has been anywhere from late October to early December. The 2026/27 opening date is not yet announced.

passes.name: Snowshoe or fat bike day pass
Kids 17 and under, adults 75 and over

downhill.name: Loup Loup Ski Bowl
downhill.alsoOnSite: 10+ km of groomed nordic trails (dog friendly), snowshoe routes, tubing, and the only alpine luge in the Pacific Northwest.
downhill.confidence: stats confirmed, 2026/27 dates and ticket prices not yet published
downhill.note: Loup Loup ran four days a week (Wednesday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday) in 2025/26 and had not posted its 2026/27 calendar as of late August 2026. Check before you build a trip around a specific day.

gettingHere.headline: Highway 20 is closed all winter. Plan the southern route.
gettingHere.detail: The North Cascades Highway (SR 20) over Rainy and Washington passes closes every winter and does not reopen until somewhere between mid April and early May. It closed on December 4 in 2025 and the eastern section did not reopen until April 30 2026. From Seattle in winter you come around the south end: I-90 or US 2 east, then north up the Columbia and into the valley. It is a longer drive than the map app will suggest in July, so give yourself the afternoon.
gettingHere.confidence: confirmed pattern, 2026/27 closure date announced only days ahead

events.name: Christmas at the End of the Road
events.what: Winthrop's flagship holiday weekend. Horse drawn sleigh rides, chainsaw carving, caroling, outdoor skating, and fireworks over Riverside Avenue. A Turkey Trot 5K opens it on Thanksgiving morning.

events.name: Mistletoe Madness
events.what: The valley's holiday shopping weekend, nine miles down the road in Twisp.

events.name: Methow Trails Film Fest
events.what: An evening of short films about the people and country the trail network runs through.

events.name: Doggie Dash
events.where: Methow Trails HQ, 21 Horizon Flats Rd
events.what: A costumed human and dog ski race the day after Christmas. Humans ski, dogs run leashed, both in costume, and there is a Golden Poodle Trophy for best in show. By donation, and the money goes to dog trail grooming.

events.name: Backyard Ski Day
events.what: Free trail access for the day. The cheapest possible way to find out whether you like skate skiing.

events.name: Ski to the Sun
events.where: Methow River to Sun Mountain Lodge
events.what: Ninth annual. Marathon, half and relay across the network. Registration opens September 21 2026.

events.name: Race of the Methow
events.dates: Early February 2027, date to be announced
events.what: Methow Valley Nordic's signature all ages race and a Junior Olympics qualifier, which brings youth teams in from across the west.

events.name: Winthrop Snowshoe Softball Tournament
events.dates: Presidents Day weekend, date to be announced
events.what: Local co-ed teams play softball on snowshoes, in costume, on the town ball field. Exactly as good as it sounds.

events.name: Winthrop Balloon Roundup
events.what: Thirtieth annual. Twenty plus hot air balloons lifting off over the valley at dawn. Free to watch, rides available.

planningWindows.label: Thanksgiving and the Christmas festival
planningWindows.why: Christmas at the End of the Road lands on Thanksgiving weekend this year.

planningWindows.label: Christmas and New Year
planningWindows.why: Christmas Day and New Year's Day both fall on a Friday, which fuses the two holidays into one continuous ten night stretch.

planningWindows.label: MLK weekend
planningWindows.why: Three day weekend, reliable mid winter grooming.

planningWindows.label: Presidents Day and Seattle mid winter break
planningWindows.why: Presidents Day is Monday February 15 and Seattle Public Schools mid winter break runs February 16 to 19, which gives Seattle families a nine day window. The strongest family week of the season.
